rows.note: Use this as the everyday all-purpose term for an edible ice-cream cone and, by extension, a traffic cone when the context is clear.

example.jyutping: ngo5 jiu3 jat1 go3 syut3 gou1 tung2

rows.note: Use this for a pine or other conifer cone; similarly shaped flower heads are usually named more specifically.

example.english: This pine cone fell onto the ground.
example.jyutping: ni1 nap1 cung4 gwo2 dit3 zo2 lok6 dei6

rows.note: Use this specifically for the light-sensitive cone cells in the retina, not for a cone-shaped object generally.

example.english: Cone cells respond differently to different colours of light.
example.traditional: 視錐細胞對唔同顏色嘅光有唔同反應。
example.jyutping: si6 zeoi1 sai3 baau1 deoi3 m4 tung4 ngaan4 sik1 ge3 gwong1 jau5 m4 tung4 faan2 jing3

rows.note: Use this for the three-dimensional geometric solid in mathematics.

example.english: This problem asks us to calculate the volume of a cone.
example.traditional: 呢條題目要我哋計圓錐體嘅體積。
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 tai4 muk6 jiu3 ngo5 dei6 gai3 jyun4 zeoi1 tai2 ge3 tai2 zik1
